titles.title: American AI Security Act
American AI Security Act
To direct the Secretary of Commerce to promulgate regulations related to certain artificial intelligence models, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Intelligence (Permanent Select), for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
